title: Substitution for minimizing/maximizing a tropical linear (fractional) programming
summary: Tropical polyhedra seem to play a central role in static analysis of softwares. These tropical geometrical objects play also a central role in parity games especially mean payoff games and energy games. And determining if an initial state of such game leads to win the game is known to be equivalent to solve a tropical linear optimization problem. This paper mainly focus on the tropical linear minimization problem using a special substitution method on the tropical cone obtained by homogenization of the initial tropical polyhedron.
